Xeniomorph Shadow
CR 11

The xeniomorph appears to be an empty suit of armor set up for display. Suddenly, the “armor” ripples and shifts, revealing a mouth full of sharp teeth in its torso along with multiple orange eyes. Its form seems to waver between solid and shadow as it moves with uncanny grace.

XP 12,800
Xeniomorph shadow 12
N Medium aberration (shapechanger)
Init +9; Senses darkvision 60 ft., blindsense 30 ft. (in dim light or darkness); Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 19, flat-footed 19 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural armor, +3 deflection)
hp 90 (12d8+36)
Fort +7, Ref +13, Will +11
Defensive Abilities evasion, improved uncanny dodge, reactive defense

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +13 (1d6+3), tongue +12 (special)
Special Attacks counterattack, misdirection, predator’s maw, redirect attack, sticky tongue
Special Abilities mimic object, shadow step, shadowcraft

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 20, Con 16, Int 16, Wis 14, Cha 10
Base Atk +9; CMB +12, CMD 30
Feats Adaptive Camouflage, Combat Expertise, Improved Initiative, Mimetic Mastery, Prehensile Tongue Mastery, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +20, Bluff +15, Climb +18, Disguise +25, Escape Artist +20, Perception +20, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +32, Survival +17
Languages Undercommon, Silent Speech (Xeniomorph), Abyssal, Common, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ghost Step (Ex)

The xeniomorph gains +6 bonus on Stealth checks.

Mimic Object (Ex)

As a standard action, can assume the shape of any Medium object, gaining a +20 racial bonus on Disguise checks to do so.

Misdirection (Ex)

The xeniomorph can use Bluff to feint in combat as a move action. On success, target is denied Dexterity bonus to AC against the next attack made by an ally before the end of the Xeniomorph’s next turn.

Morphic Insight

Once per day, the xeniomorph can gain a +2 insight bonus on a single Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma check related to understanding or interacting with an object they’ve successfully mimicked.

Predator’s Maw (Ex)

The xeniomorph’s bite attack deals 1d8+3 damage. Once per day, it can increase damage to 1d10+3 and gain +2 on attack roll, plus 1 point of bleed damage.

Redirect Attack (Ex)

When missed by a melee attack, the xeniomorph can attempt to redirect that attack to another creature adjacent to both the Xeniomorph and the attacker. The attacker must make a new attack roll against the new target. Usable 2/day.

Shadow Powers
Shadow Blend (concealment in dim light), Silent Step (move up to speed as part of Stealth check without penalty), Shadow Sight: darkvision 90 ft.
Improved Feint: Target denied Dexterity bonus to AC against Xeniomorph’s attacks until end of its next turn on successful feint.
Shadow Step (Su)

The xeniomorph can teleport between areas of dim light or darkness within 60 feet as a move action, 2/day.

Shadowcraft (Su)

The xeniomorph can create small visual illusions within 10 feet. Will DC 18 to disbelieve.

Sticky Tongue (Ex)

The xeniomorph may attack targets at 15 ft. range as a secondary attack. The target cannot move more than 10 ft. away and takes -2 penalty to AC while attached. Can be removed with opposed Strength check or by dealing 2 damage to tongue (AC 11).

ECOLOGY

Environment any underground or urban
Organization solitary, pair, or enclave (3–8)
Treasure Standard

In combat, the xeniomorph relies on stealth and misdirection. It begins encounters hidden, using its Mimic Object ability to blend in with the environment. When combat starts, it uses Shadowcraft to create distractions while positioning itself advantageously. It prefers to attack from concealment, using its Ghost Step and Shadow Blend abilities to remain hidden. The Xeniomorph uses its Sticky Tongue to control enemy movement and set up advantageous positions for its allies. When directly engaged, it utilizes its Redirect Attack and Counterattack abilities to turn enemies’ strength against them. If overwhelmed, it uses Shadow Step to quickly reposition or escape.
